title: Gáspár et al. (2026): The JWST/NIRCam Scattered Light Disks GTO 2780 program: panchromatic coronagraphic imaging of the HD 10647, HD 32297, HD 61005, HD 107146, and HD 181327 debris disk systems

evidence.locator: Abstract: five disks (HD 10647, HD 32297, HD 61005, HD 107146, HD 181327) imaged in six NIRCam filters with the coronagraphs; HD 181327 section: cold ring 75-85 au with its peak at 80 au, inclination 28.54 +/- 0.31 degrees, position angle 100.39 +/- 0.63 degrees; observed 2023-10-11 after a failed roll on 2023-09-13
